replacement.name: Vivanta Aurangabad
replacement.tagline: Taj-IHCL's Vivanta near Bibi Ka Maqbara — 113 rooms, outdoor pool, Mynt fine-dining and Latitude buffet. The Taj-group service base for a pre-dawn departure to Ajanta opening at 9 AM.

replacement.name: Lemon Tree Premier Aurangabad
replacement.tagline: Citrus-design Premier-tier 4 km from Aurangabad airport — pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, consistent brand service at 30–40% less than the Taj Vivanta. The reliable Ajanta/Ellora day-trip base.
replacement.address: R-3 Chikalthana, Jalna Road, Aurangabad 431210, Maharashtra

replacement.name: The Meadows Hotel & Resort
replacement.tagline: 37-cottage garden resort on Mitmita Road, 5 km from Aurangabad railway and 8 km from Bibi-Ka-Maqbara — outdoor pool, in-house Maharashtrian restaurant, on-call taxi for the Ajanta-Ellora-Daulatabad triangle.

replacement.name: WelcomHotel by ITC Rama International
replacement.tagline: ITC's WelcomHotel Rama International on Jalna Road — 134 rooms across landscaped grounds 3 km from Chikalthana airport, outdoor pool, the longest-running 5-star service brand in Aurangabad city.
replacement.address: R-3 Chikalthana, Jalna Road, Aurangabad 431210, Maharashtra
